official_measurement_examples.name: Current Approved Document G edition
official_measurement_examples.fact: The GOV.UK Approved Document G page was last updated 1 October 2024 and incorporates the May 2024 amendments.

official_measurement_examples.name: Mandatory water efficiency level
official_measurement_examples.fact: Building Regulations regulation 36 sets a 125 litres per person per day maximum for applicable new dwellings unless the optional 110 litre requirement applies.

official_measurement_examples.name: Optional 110 litre level
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document G records the 110 litres per person per day level as an optional requirement that applies where the planning-permission mechanism triggers it.

official_measurement_examples.name: Regulation 36 dwelling scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: The statutory water-efficiency rule applies to dwellings erected or formed by specified material changes of use, not to every building project.

official_measurement_examples.name: Water-efficiency notice
official_measurement_examples.fact: Regulation 37 requires the calculated wholesome-water consumption information to be notified to the local authority where regulation 36 applies.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2016 commencement and transition
official_measurement_examples.fact: The amended Approved Document G took effect on 1 March 2016 with stated transitional arrangements for earlier notices, plans and work.

official_measurement_examples.name: Future water-fittings specifications
official_measurement_examples.fact: Defra published approved water-fittings specifications on 6 May 2026 that are stated to apply from 6 May 2027.

official_measurement_examples.name: Water Fittings Regulations commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 came into force on 1 July 1999 and are enforced by water undertakers for public supplies.
